parent.title: Beatsmaxxer Pro: responsiveness, UI and musical workflows completion
parent.description:
Owner scope, November 5, 2026: focus Beatsmaxxer Pro web/shared desktop and related Experimental Desktop work. The separate Beatsmaxxer Native / beatsmaxxer-resolume product is explicitly excluded.

Outcome: fast measured interaction and stable musical video playback on Windows desktop and physical MacBook; substantial UI pass with simple first-use workflow and discoverable advanced controls; visibly distinct musical presets and reusable workflow content.

Start main 2b531ff. Inventory: 51 Pro issues, 49 Done and 2 Canceled. Preserve completed/canceled history. Verify current behavior and create scoped follow-ups for measured gaps.

Delivery: frequent intended-path commits and branch pushes; substantial coherent PRs; automatic merge only after required checks, affected runtime/export/platform acceptance, applicable repository reviewer, and Greptile 5/5 on the current reviewed revision. Score does not replace acceptance. Verify exact-main deployment and public flows.

Plan/evidence: docs/qa/completion-2026-11-05/, branch codex/completion-verification.

Acceptance includes input-to-visible response, cut/source cadence, audio sync, resource convergence, startup, mixed 480p/720p/1080p media, offline/server failure, save/load, inspected song/loop exports and physical platform behavior. Missing Mac/hardware evidence stays pending; no universal zero-latency claims.

Preserve visual identity, simplify entry/presets/primary controls, retain deep control. No framework migration.

children.title: Measure input latency, workspace lifecycle and long-session resource stability
children.description: Baseline actual UI interactions during twelve-slot Perform/Timing playback. Add fail-closed workspace/browser visibility/resource gates; run straight/swing/dotted and order variants, effect-aware temporal tests and repeated long sessions. Record event-to-visible p50/p95/max, long tasks, source/render gaps, audio drift, pending uploads, active bindings, decoder and residency counts. Preserve thresholds and failing evidence. No performance claims from unit tests alone.

children.title: Define and verify mixed-resolution media, preview memory and native export quality
children.description: Test 480p/720p/1080p mixed order, portrait/4:3/square/16:9, common native rates and variable FPS, supported/unsupported codecs and corrupt files. Resolve first-source-dependent Timing export dimensions through explicit saved output policy. Preserve original detail; expose Ramp worker <=720p preparation and resource limits honestly. Verify cancellation/retry/cache reuse/offline service failures and inspect actual exported picture/audio.

children.title: Redesign the Pro workflow with simple primary controls and discoverable advanced editing
children.description: Substantial UI pass on existing Svelte/WebGPU app. Preserve Beatsmaxxer identity and functional control. Provide clear song -> musical edit -> refine -> export path, useful initial workspace, legible hierarchy and states, a few primary controls with deeper options available. Show before/after actual browser evidence at MacBook/desktop/narrow widths. Test keyboard/accessibility, save/load/undo, no clipped controls and input responsiveness under playback.

children.title: Make musical presets visibly distinct and ship reusable workflow content
children.description: Create a small curated set of contrasting music/edit workflows using approved existing footage/audio and reusable banks. Each preset must visibly change results on the same reference phrase, follow beat/MIDI/audio trigger timing, avoid misleading no-op settings, roundtrip save/load, replay and export. Include simple expressive macros with editable advanced settings. Existing media first; any new content creation uses approved references and corresponding creative workflow.

children.title: Verify physical MacBook browser and installed Windows Pro performance
children.description: Record actual OS/browser/WebView/GPU/audio/media/output/hardware for each run. Physical MacBook Chrome and Safari capability/behavior, Windows Chrome/Edge and installed Tauri: cold/warm start, sustained playback, tempo/pitch/preset/drag changes, browser background return, minimize/restore, fullscreen and display changes. Mac desktop currently unshipped; do not certify it from frontend-only smoke. Record available Mac access/build feasibility before expanding packaging.

children.title: Deliver Experimental Desktop output, lighting and beat-switched looks with measured acceptance
children.description: Reconcile archived backlog <issue id="b38731c2-6774-44df-9a3a-164d49075ba4" label="V1S-205" href="https://linear.app/v1su4/issue/V1S-205/spec-show-output-projection-mapping-footage-driven-live-lighting-art" />/207/208/209. Design same-device output/transfer ownership before multi-window changes. Projection: corner-pin/mesh, masks, blend, saved mapping, two physical outputs at60fps/eight decks and live edits. Lighting: sampled PGM, Rust Art-Net/sACN, viewer >=40Hz and measured latency. Looks: atomic beat/bar bundle switching, energy tiers, hold actions and controller mapping. Hardware gaps stay pending; simulators do not replace physical acceptance.

children.title: Release substantial verified chunks with current Greptile 5/5 and exact production proof
children.description: Frequent scoped commits and pushes. For each substantial PR, inspect current diff/required checks/review comments. Fix findings, obtain Greptile5/5 for reviewed current revision and applicable repo reviewer, then merge automatically. Exact-main managed deployment, public workflow playback/export, install/update/relaunch evidence where affected. Final goal closes only after every in-scope child and experiment has acceptance evidence.
